guides.control_name: Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution
guides.vulnerability_name: Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution
guides.recommended_action:
Recommended monitoring actions:
- Review security logs and alerts related to Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution on affected hosts.
- Track patch, configuration, and exposure status until the risk is formally reassessed.
- Collect monitoring evidence such as scan results, SIEM alerts, tickets, or screenshots.
- Escalate repeated suspicious activity or failed remediation for corrective action.

implementation_steps.title: Capture Current Host Monitoring Baseline
implementation_steps.description: Collect a current technical baseline for WS-01 to confirm the host state, active services, and network exposure relevant to Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution (CVE-2019-0708) on the Finance Workstation role.

implementation_steps.output_type: Command output / service status / network connection list
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Capture the service and network output for WS-01 as the baseline monitoring evidence.

implementation_steps.title: Review Security Events And Alerts
implementation_steps.description:
Review recent Windows security activity on WS-01 and collect monitoring output that supports the approved action: Recommended monitoring actions:
- Review security logs and alerts related to Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution on affected hosts.
- Track patch, configuration, and exposure status until the risk is formally reassessed.
- Collect monitoring evidence such as scan results, SIEM alerts, tickets, or screenshots.
- Escalate repeated suspicious activity or failed remediation for corrective action.
implementation_steps.expected_result: Recent security and system events are available for analyst review and can be correlated with monitoring activity for Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution.
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Export or screenshot the relevant Security and System log entries for WS-01.

implementation_steps.title: Validate Exposure And Remediation Status
implementation_steps.description: Check patch state, configuration state, or exposure indicators on WS-01 to confirm whether Remote Desktop Services Remote Code Execution (CVE-2019-0708) remains exposed while monitoring continues.
implementation_steps.expected_result: Patch and configuration evidence shows the current remediation state for WS-01 and supports ongoing monitoring decisions.
implementation_steps.output_type: Patch list / firewall rule list / command output
implementation_steps.evidence_capture: Capture patch validation output, firewall or configuration output, and any related scan result used to confirm the current state on WS-01.
